name: Orchestration Panel
description: Visual multi-agent task DAG workbench for Orca: live coordination modes, hexagonal approval gates, scoped Session wakeups, native resume, and a self-hosted embedded backend.

cover.alt: Orchestration Panel four-zone dark IDE workbench showing a multi-agent task DAG, hexagonal gate, and live messages.

screenshots.alt: Orchestration Panel dark workbench with DAG canvas, Fleet sidebar, hexagonal approval gate, and Messages inspector.
screenshots.caption: 4-zone DAG workbench with hexagonal approval gates, retained model and worktree chips, and live coordinator messages.

settings.title: Refresh Session on tool events
settings.description: Use agent.tool.after to wake matching worker transcript reads early. Does not send tool previews or disable regular transcript reads.

settings.title: Gate and failure notifications
settings.description: Show desktop notifications when a Run has a pending gate, permission prompt, or failed worker.
